english.title: In charge of animal carried in vehicle fail to prevent it remaining on motorway other than hard shoulder / refuge area
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being a person in charge of **(..SPECIFY THE ANIMAL..) which was being carried by a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), using the **(..SPECIFY THE MOTORWAY AND LOCATION..), failed to secure, insofar as was practicable, that the animal, having

(A)_[escaped from]_
(B)_[been removed from or permitted to leave]_

the vehicle, did not go or remain on a part of the motorway other than the hard shoulder or emergency refuge area
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 14(b)(i) of the Motorways Traffic (England and Wales) Regulations 1982, section 17(4) of the Road Traffic Regulation Act 1984 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
being person in charge of an animal
being carried by a vehicle using a motorway
the animal had escaped / been removed / permitted to leave

english.notes: Statement of Facts procedure applies - see end of document for wording.
english.standardstatementoffacts:
At **(..SPECIFY TIME..) on **(..SPECIFY DATE..) the defendant was in charge of **(..SPECIFY ANIMAL..) which was being carried in **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..) on the **(..SPECIFY THE MOTORWAY AND LOCATION..). The animal had

(A)_[escaped from]_
(B)_[been removed from or permitted to leave]_

the vehicle but the defendant allowed it to go onto or remain on a part of the motorway other than the hard shoulder or emergency refuge area, namely **(..SPECIFY THE PART..).

other.penalty:
A fine not exceeding level four on the standard scale.

Obligatory endorsement - licence endorsed three penalty points.

Discretionary disqualification.

Fixed penalty ticket - one hundred pounds and licence endorsed three penalty points.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months
